baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coupled near-action and swallowing construction at words 3-4, together with the ongoing gulping at word 1.
baseline_models.mechanism: Near-performance is coupled to the negation of smooth throat-passage. Intake occurs, but completion is held at the threshold, producing repeated attempted transit rather than one simple failed swallow.

activation_trace.role: Near-performance supplies the threshold state in which swallowing is approached but not securely completed.
Refusal under negation makes the threshold active non-completion rather than mere slowness.
Smooth descent through the throat is the missing terminal operation around which the ordeal turns.

changed_reading.before: He has difficulty swallowing a dreadful drink.
changed_reading.after: He is held in a near-passage loop: gulping occurs while smooth transit is repeatedly withheld.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Death comes from every place at words 5-9, yet the subject is explicitly not dead at words 10-12.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival, exhaustive spatial distribution, and the resulting state are separated. Death is present as an incoming event at every coordinate but withheld as terminal release, so non-death prolongs rather than mitigates the assault.

activation_trace.role: Arrival gives death active ingress toward the subject rather than leaving it an abstract possibility.
Loss of force and life supplies the terminal state that the second occurrence explicitly denies.
Exhaustive inclusion turns the incoming death into total rather than local pressure.
Place and emplacement distribute the approach across the subject's whole spatial field.

changed_reading.before: Many mortal dangers surround him, but he survives.
changed_reading.after: Death is ubiquitously present while its completing effect is withheld; survival keeps every mortal approach operative.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing construction at words 14-16 follows an already exhaustive approach of death.
baseline_models.mechanism: The breadth of 'beyond/behind' prevents the current near-death scene from becoming an endpoint. A further punishment occupies the other side of the ordeal, and thickness gives that surplus both material density and interpersonal severity.

activation_trace.role: The other side can be behind, ahead, or after, preserving a further layer without forcing one orientation.
Painful penalty identifies the further layer as intensification rather than exit.
Physical thickness gives the future penalty density and resistance.
Harsh treatment keeps the material image tied to direct punitive severity.

changed_reading.before: A severe punishment follows the swallowing and near-death.
changed_reading.after: Swallowing and ubiquitous death form only a threshold; another dense punitive layer remains beyond them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier torment joins throat-cutting to deliberate preservation of life. That social technology revises the focus paradox: 'not dead' can be an actively maintained condition inside punishment, not a merciful failure of punishment.

activation_trace.role: The focus names loss of life and then denies that terminal state, supplying the paradox to be revised.
Punitive pain frames the paired killing and life-preservation as one tormenting regime.
Cutting the throat supplies the explicit terminal bodily operation.
Preserving life and leaving killing undone supplies the active counterpart to denied death.

structural_cues: 14:6 places slaughter and deliberate life-preservation side by side within a named evil torment; 14:17 likewise places arriving death beside explicit non-death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a punitive regime that both kills and keeps alive. I infer that maintained survival can itself be punitive in 14:17. A live alternative is that 14:6 only contrasts victim groups and does not explain the later paradox.

changed_reading.before: Death fails to finish the sufferer despite approaching from everywhere.
changed_reading.after: Life may be actively retained as part of torment, just as selective survival functions inside the earlier punitive regime.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sought opening fails for the coercive tyrant; immediately afterward, drink is administered. The focus then supplies a throat whose passage nearly but never cleanly opens. Together the cues render forced irrigation into a closed conduit.

activation_trace.role: Missing smooth throat-passage is the closed conduit activated by the context.
Opening a closure supplies the gate image transferred to the throat.
Failure to attain the sought result makes opening abort rather than resolve.
Compulsion converts drinking from ordinary intake into an imposed bodily process.
Administering drink supplies the forced input the focus must attempt to pass.
Water identifies the material delivered to the obstructed conduit.

structural_cues: 14:15 ends with frustrated opening and the coercive tyrant; 14:16 uses passive drink-administration; 14:17 begins with pronoun-dependent ongoing gulping.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, failure, coercion, administered water, and failed throat-passage in sequence. I infer a gate-and-conduit mechanism. A live alternative is that the opening remains solely judicial or victorious.

changed_reading.before: An individual struggles to swallow a repellent liquid.
changed_reading.after: A punitive system forces liquid into him while withholding the opening needed for passage, making administration and obstruction cooperate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere, water travels through open channels, supports provision, and accompanies durable life. The focus preserves liquid and persistence but removes flow and nourishment. It is an anti-garden hydraulic system: intake reaches the throat, circulation stops, and endurance becomes punitive.

activation_trace.role: Failed descent supplies the local blockage against which successful water movement is read.
Free running and spreading provide the positive flow operation absent from the focus.
A channel cut through earth by running water supplies open circulation.
Durable persistence shows a life-giving counterpart to punitive non-death.
Delivered water supplies a successful upstream input to the creation-wide flow system.
Nourishing sustenance names the output successful water movement produces and the focus lacks.

structural_cues: 14:23 couples running rivers with abiding life.
14:32 couples water with fruit, provision, travel, and subjected rivers; 14:17 arrests liquid at the throat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successful water networks and a failed local passage. I infer a cross-scale hydraulic inversion from river to throat. A live alternative is a simple paradise-versus-punishment contrast without a shared flow mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The drink is one isolated instrument of pain.
changed_reading.after: The focus is an inverted life-system: water arrives but cannot circulate into nourishment, while the subject endures without the vitality that flow normally sustains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The tree sequence offers productive rooted life on one side and complete uprooting without stability on the other. The focus activates an impossible third condition: ingestion without nourishment and loss of vitality without completed death.

activation_trace.role: Blocked throat-passage prevents intake from becoming nourishment.
Loss of vitality is present but denied completion, fixing the subject between life and eradication.
The good-versus-corrupt distinction defines the productive pole of the vegetative contrast.
Yield from tree and crop supplies successful nutritive output.
Recurring time gives productive life a rhythm contrasting the focus's repeated non-completion.
Complete extraction from the root supplies the terminal alternative denied to the subject.
Stability defines what the uprooted tree lacks and the suspended sufferer cannot possess.

structural_cues: 14:24-26 forms a binary between a fixed, repeatedly nourishing tree and a wholly uprooted tree with no stability; 14:17 combines failed intake with non-death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two tree outcomes and the focus's blocked intake/non-death pair. I infer a third, arrested metabolic state. A live alternative is that the tree contrast concerns speech and belief only.

changed_reading.before: The sufferer neither swallows normally nor dies.
changed_reading.after: He is held between fruiting life and complete uprooting, unable to convert intake into life yet denied eradication.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same arrival/giving root and exhaustive quantifier occur in beneficent distribution from everything requested and in death coming from every place. Every possible inlet changes from a channel of gift into a channel of mortality.

activation_trace.role: Incoming arrival makes death the payload distributed toward the subject.
Exhaustive inclusion closes every spatial exception.
Giving supplies the beneficent incoming movement the focus reverses.
The same exhaustive scope distributes requested provision without an omitted category.

structural_cues: 14:34 and 14:17 share an incoming ء ت ي event and the frame 'from every ...', but exchange requested gift for death and requested things for places.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a close root-and-construction recurrence with opposite payloads. I infer distributive inversion. A live alternative is that the recurrence only expresses totality in unrelated domains.

changed_reading.after: Every channel through which provision could arrive has been inverted into an inlet of death; enclosure becomes corrupted abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Explicit postponement supplies timing, while fixed sight, non-returning eye movement, and void hearts distribute non-completion through the body. The focus's blocked throat and denied death become a scheduled somatic arrest rather than accidental survival.

activation_trace.role: The throat's failed transit supplies the first bodily circuit that does not complete.
Explicit non-death keeps the stalled body present.
Postponement to a later time supplies deliberate temporal withholding.
A bounded duration gives withholding an appointed container.
Fixed staring supplies an eye held at the limit of movement.
Failed return supplies another motion that begins but does not complete its circuit.
Blinking and sight locate non-return in an ordinary repetitive bodily operation.
A heart weakened as though absent supplies internal depletion without disappearance.
Void and empty space turn the heart into an evacuated interior.

structural_cues: 14:42 explains apparent non-action as postponement; 14:42-43 then distributes arrested motion across gaze, returning sight, and heart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies postponement and several somatic non-completions. I infer that 'death from every place' includes scheduled failure of bodily circuits. A live alternative is that the later images describe pre-judgment fear independently of the focus.

changed_reading.before: External causes of death converge on a still-living subject.
changed_reading.after: The subject is retained on a schedule while throat, gaze, and heart enter deathlike arrested states without completing death.

context_deltas.mechanism: Punishment later arrives, the wrongdoers request postponement, and their former claim of no cessation is returned against them. The focus's non-death becomes ironic persistence: what does not cease is now the punitive state from which death offers no change.

activation_trace.role: The negated terminal state makes cessation through death unavailable.
Punishment's arrival repeats the focus's incoming movement.
Painful penalty is the arriving event from which delay is requested.
The request for later time shows postponement becoming desired only once punishment arrives.
Departure from a place or condition supplies the cessation once claimed impossible and now needed.

structural_cues: 14:44 sequences arriving punishment, a request for delay, and a rebuke recalling 'no cessation'; 14:17 sequences arriving death and explicit non-death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the rebuked boast and the persistent punitive sequence. I infer ironic reversal in which non-cessation becomes punishment. A live alternative is that the boast concerns worldly displacement only.

changed_reading.before: Not dying merely permits punishment to continue.
changed_reading.after: Not dying is an ironic denial of cessation: worldly permanence is returned as inability to leave the punitive condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is replaceable and everyone exposed; bodies are then linked, bound, clothed in pitch, and covered at the face. The focus contributes the occupied inner conduit. Death from every place becomes a fitted inside-out topology in which neither world, relation, limb, surface, nor throat offers refuge.

activation_trace.role: The obstructed throat places punishment inside the body's transit route.
Place anchors the spatial field whose stability the later replacement removes.
One thing standing in place of another makes the containing world replaceable.
The lower spatial ground is the substrate subjected to replacement.
Emergence into exposure removes enclosure as protection.
Overpowering from above removes the autonomy of every position.
Joining and tying body to body supplies relational constraint.
Fetters supply direct restriction of limb movement.
A worn garment makes punishment conform to the body's outer shape.
Oozing pitch supplies an adhesive material layer at the surface.
An encompassing covering completes the external enclosure.
The face identifies the forward boundary covered by fire.

structural_cues: 14:48 replaces the ground and exposes everyone; 14:49-50 moves through inter-body coupling, limb restraint, worn material, and facial covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies world-replacement and successive inner, relational, and surface constraints. I infer one topology of enclosure. A live alternative is that these are independent punishment images rather than one spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Death converges from many external directions in an otherwise stable place.
changed_reading.after: Place itself is unstable, while punishment occupies every bodily scale from throat to relation, limb, garment, and face.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps speech and message-routing onto digestion, and the hand-to-mouth construction in 14:9 remains syntactically open. It remains anchored in failed throat-passage while packet branches supply mouth-opening, rejection, reaching, and conveying. Render it only as a cross-domain transmission analogy, not as a claim that 14:9 predicts the drink.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The object reaches the mouth but does not achieve smooth onward passage at word 4.

activation_trace.role: Failed throat transit supplies blocked physical transmission.
Non-acceptance supplies earlier communicative refusal.
Opening the mouth for speech locates refusal at the bodily gate later used for drinking.
Reaching an endpoint supplies successful transmission that the focus reverses.
Conveying a message makes the surah delivered content against the focus's undelivered draught.

changed_reading.before: Failed swallowing is solely physical torment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also failed transmission: the mouth that rejected warning becomes a gate where imposed material cannot reach its destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes severity through a later mountain image. It remains anchored in the focus's thickness branch and packet branches for mountain solidity, bodily thickness, and displacement. Render it as an activated material analogy, not as the lexical definition of the punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final adjective at word 16 describes the punishment as thick or harsh.

activation_trace.role: Physical thickness permits severity to be imagined as dense material.
Harsh treatment keeps materialization tied to direct punitive sense.
Displacement from position supplies movement against which dense punishment resists.
A raised solid mass gives punishment mountain-like scale and resistance.
Thickness of bodily formation bridges mountain materiality to the focus adjective.

changed_reading.before: A harsh punishment remains beyond the ordeal.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the punishment beyond is a mountain-dense mass with scale and resistance to displacement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the 14:51 occurrence ordinarily denotes the self, while one packet branch activates a breath or sip. It remains anchored in explicit gulping and 14:51's exhaustive individualized repayment. Render it as an exploratory metrical analogy, not as replacement of 'self' by 'sip.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The subject takes the object gulp by gulp at word 1 but cannot make it pass at word 4.

activation_trace.role: Failed passage keeps each gulp perceptible as an unfinished unit.
Corresponding deed with recompense supplies the accounting relation assigned to each unit.
Exhaustive inclusion makes repayment omit no self and, analogically, no installment.
A drinking breath or sip bridges each self to the focus's gulping.
Acquired gain supplies what individualized recompense answers.

changed_reading.before: Gulping is repetitive pain without an internal measure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each obstructed gulp becomes an installment in individualized repayment corresponding to what each self acquired.

strongest_changes: The immediate 14:15-16 sequence turns difficult swallowing into coerced delivery through a gate that will not fully open.
Garden, river, tree, and provision sequences recast the focus as anti-flow and arrested metabolism.
The matched arrival/giving and exhaustive roots in 14:34 invert every channel of provision into every channel of death.
Delay, bodily arrest, world-replacement, fetters, garments, and covering expand non-death into scheduled, somatic, and spatially total enclosure.
The 14:51 sip branch preserves an exploratory reading of gulping as individualized installments of recompense.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly supplies successful passage, nourishment, provision, settlement, and transmission. The focus arrests each process after arrival but before completion, making withheld completion the common mechanism across swallowing, death, place, and punishment.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet provides no branch inventory for the focus root ج ر ع, so the iterative gulp anchor relies on the focus surface and adjacent ك و د and س و غ inventories.
Hydraulic and vegetative readings may be deliberate antithetical structures or broad paradise-punishment contrasts.
The temporal reading may transfer pre-judgment postponement in 14:42 into a scene already depicting punishment.
Mountain materialization and the sip sense of ن ف س remain branch-distant and must stay explicitly exploratory.
